What does a better future look like to you?

A better future looks different for each of us, until you look at what we all need: safe and stable communities, work that supports us, a home we can afford, access to the care we need, and enough security to plan for tomorrow. A healthy economy should make those things possible. And we can build one.

Who we are

We are a group of people with varied perspectives who have come together to build community and move toward a better economy and future. We approach the world's complexities with curiosity and honesty, navigating uncertainty through understanding. We hope you'll join us in imagining a better future.

Our Manifesto

The laws and policies we make shape the path our economy takes and, in turn, the lives people are able to build.

Right now, our economy leaves too many people stranded, concentrating gains among the already wealthy, chasing quick returns over stability, and fueling boom-bust cycles that strain households and the natural systems we depend on.

This economic uncertainty hurts families and communities. It makes it hard for people to envision and build a future.

We believe we can redesign the economy, and that starts by redefining how we think about economic well-being. Our economy should be judged by what it gives us: security, opportunity, stability, and a good quality of life, now and for generations to come.
